## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Protocol/unit tests pass
- [ ] Python files compile
- [ ] HACS validation passes

## Protocol changes

If this changes BLE commands, include the observed packet(s) and how they were independently verified on hardware. Do not include private device identifiers.
